issues.on_page: Support services: Special education 307,796 (budget schedule p10 function code 2141-2183)
issues.issue: Codes 2141-2183 are the SPED related support services (psychological, speech, OT/PT, visually impaired). The user's school rule puts these in support services with detail_category Pupils; Special Education Programs is for the 1200 instructional programs only. Gering, for example, records its 2141-2183 lines as Pupils.
Same issue as disbursements[3]: SPED related services (2141-2183) are support services (Pupils) under the user's school-district rule.
